zh.title: 有人突然走到电脑旁，怎样快速保护当前内容？
zh.description: 有人突然走到 Windows 电脑旁时，怎样快速隐藏当前内容、锁屏并保护私密文件。
zh.shortAnswer: 先执行最容易成功、对当前工作影响最小的动作：人在电脑前可用快捷键隐藏或锁屏；已经离开电脑时，再依赖事先配置好的设备或摄像头触发。

sections.heading: 先按距离选择动作
paragraphs: 如果手还在键盘附近，快捷键通常最直接。只是需要暂时遮住内容时，可先隐藏或最小化窗口；对方可能接触电脑时，应优先锁定 Windows。
如果您已经离开座位，临时再设置触发来不及。U 盘拔出、蓝牙断开或离席检测都需要提前配置和试用，不能把第一次使用留到紧急时刻。
bullets: 短暂遮挡：隐藏或最小化当前窗口
阻止继续操作：锁定 Windows
涉及私密文件：同时使用已锁定的保险箱

en.title: How can I quickly protect my screen when someone walks up to my PC?
en.description: Quickly choose between hiding current content, locking Windows, and protecting private files when someone walks up to a PC.
en.shortAnswer: Use the fastest reliable action with the least impact: hide windows or lock Windows when you are at the keyboard; rely on a preconfigured device or camera trigger only after you have stepped away.

sections.heading: Choose by distance first
paragraphs: A shortcut is usually the quickest option while your hand is near the keyboard. Hide or minimize windows for brief visual cover; lock Windows if the other person may touch the PC.
Once you are away, it is too late to configure a trigger. USB removal, Bluetooth disconnect, and away detection should be set up and tried before an urgent moment.
bullets: Brief visual cover: hide or minimize current windows
Prevent further use: lock Windows
Sensitive files: keep them in a locked vault as well

zh.title: 来不及碰键盘和鼠标时，怎样保护电脑隐私？
zh.description: 无法立刻操作键盘和鼠标时，使用可信设备或摄像头触发 Windows 隐私保护的准备方法。
zh.shortAnswer: 只能依靠提前启用并验证过的远距离触发，例如拔出随身 U 盘、蓝牙设备离开连接范围或摄像头手势；没有预先配置时，软件无法替您判断现场意图。

sections.heading: 远距离触发必须提前准备
paragraphs: U 盘适合能顺手拔走设备的情况，蓝牙适合人和随身设备一起离开，摄像头手势适合仍在镜头范围但不方便触碰电脑的情况。
任何自动方式都可能受到设备连接、遮挡、距离和环境影响。设置后应在安全场景中多次试用，并保留一个手动快捷键作为备用。
bullets: 不要同时启用过多未经验证的触发
先使用隐藏或锁屏等可恢复动作
把重启、关机等高影响动作保持为关闭

en.title: How can I protect privacy when I cannot reach the keyboard or mouse?
en.description: Prepare device or camera triggers for moments when the keyboard and mouse are out of reach.
en.shortAnswer: You need a trigger that was enabled and tested in advance, such as removing a USB device, moving a Bluetooth device out of range, or using a camera gesture. Without prior setup, software cannot infer your intent in the moment.

sections.heading: Prepare remote triggers before you need them
paragraphs: USB removal works when you can take the device with you. Bluetooth suits leaving with a wearable or phone. A camera gesture can help while you remain visible but cannot touch the PC.
Automatic triggers depend on connection quality, distance, visibility, and the environment. Try the setup several times in a safe situation and retain a manual shortcut as a fallback.
bullets: Avoid enabling many untested triggers at once
Start with reversible actions such as hiding or locking
Keep restart and shutdown actions disabled unless truly needed

zh.title: 紧急时应该锁屏，还是只隐藏窗口？
zh.description: 比较 Windows 锁屏与隐藏窗口在紧急隐私保护中的用途和限制。
zh.shortAnswer: 只需要短暂遮挡屏幕内容时可隐藏窗口；只要存在他人继续操作电脑的可能，就应锁屏。两者都不能替代私密文件本身的加密保护。

sections.heading: 两种动作解决不同问题
paragraphs: 隐藏窗口对当前工作打断较小，但电脑仍处于可操作状态，熟悉电脑的人也可能重新找到窗口。Windows 锁屏会要求重新登录，更适合离开座位或有人可能接触设备的情况。
如果担心的是文件在磁盘上被打开或复制，还需要把文件放入受保护的保险箱，并在离开前确认保险箱已锁定。
bullets: 隐藏窗口：快、影响小，但不是访问控制
Windows 锁屏：阻止当前登录会话被直接使用
保险箱锁定：保护其中的文件访问

en.title: In an urgent moment, should I lock Windows or only hide windows?
en.description: Compare Windows lock and window hiding for emergency privacy protection.
en.shortAnswer: Hide windows for brief visual cover. Lock Windows whenever someone might continue using the PC. Neither action replaces encryption for sensitive files.

sections.heading: The actions solve different problems
paragraphs: Hiding windows interrupts work less, but the PC remains usable and another person may find the windows again. Windows lock requires signing in again and is better when you leave or someone may touch the device.
If your concern is opening or copying files from storage, keep those files in a protected vault and confirm that the vault is locked before leaving.
bullets: Hide windows: fast and low-impact, but not access control
Lock Windows: prevents direct use of the current session
Lock the vault: protects access to files inside it

zh.title: 保护隐私时，怎样尽量不丢失未保存的工作？
zh.description: 配置紧急隐私动作时，如何优先保护未保存工作并避免高影响操作。
zh.shortAnswer: 把隐藏窗口或 Windows 锁屏作为第一层动作，先关闭可能导致数据丢失的强制关闭、重启和关机；重要文档仍应依赖应用自身的保存与恢复能力。

sections.heading: 从可恢复动作开始
paragraphs: 隐藏和锁屏通常不会主动结束应用，更适合作为默认保护动作。锁定保险箱前，应保存正在编辑且位于保险箱中的文件，并关闭占用这些文件的应用。
强制关闭应用、强制锁定或卸载、重启和关机都可能让未保存内容丢失。只有明确接受后果时才启用，并先用不重要的测试文件验证自己的流程。
bullets: 养成频繁保存和启用自动保存的习惯
先关闭保险箱中文件，再锁定保险箱
高影响动作默认保持关闭

en.title: How can I protect privacy without losing unsaved work?
en.description: Prioritize unsaved work and avoid high-impact actions when configuring emergency privacy protection.
en.shortAnswer: Use window hiding or Windows lock as the first layer, and leave force-close, restart, and shutdown actions disabled. Important documents should still rely on the application's save and recovery features.

sections.heading: Start with reversible actions
paragraphs: Hiding and locking normally leave applications running, so they are safer defaults. Before locking a vault, save files being edited inside it and close applications that are using those files.

Force-closing applications, force-locking or unmounting, restarting, and shutting down can lose unsaved content. Enable them only when you accept that consequence, and first test your workflow with unimportant files.
bullets: Save frequently and enable application autosave
Close files stored in the vault before locking it
Leave high-impact actions disabled by default

zh.title: 老板或主管突然走到电脑旁，怎样保护办公隐私？
zh.description: 老板或主管突然靠近办公电脑时，怎样快速处理屏幕上的私人内容、客户资料和未保存工作。
zh.shortAnswer: 先按内容敏感程度选择隐藏窗口或锁定 Windows，不要在慌乱中强制关闭应用。超级看门狗不判断您正在保护什么，是否触发以及执行哪些动作都由您提前决定。

sections.heading: 把办公隐私和工作连续性一起考虑
paragraphs: 如果只是临时避免旁人看到当前窗口，可使用事先设置的快捷触发隐藏目标窗口；如果对方可能操作电脑，锁定 Windows 更合适。客户信息、合同或报价单还应遵守公司制度和访问权限要求。
软件不会识别内容属于工作、私人还是其他类别，也不会替用户判断现场关系。用户自行选择要处理的窗口、触发方式和动作，并应只用于合法合规的个人隐私与资料保护。
bullets: 短暂遮挡：隐藏事先选定的窗口
可能离开座位：锁定 Windows
重要资料：同时遵守单位的数据管理制度

en.title: How can I protect office privacy when a manager suddenly walks over?
en.description: Handle private content, client records, and unsaved work when a manager or supervisor suddenly approaches an office PC.
en.shortAnswer: Choose window hiding or Windows lock according to the sensitivity and avoid force-closing applications in a panic. SuperWatchDog does not decide what you are protecting; you choose the trigger and actions in advance.

sections.heading: Balance office privacy with work continuity
paragraphs: For brief visual privacy, use a configured trigger to hide selected windows. Lock Windows if someone may use the PC. Client records, contracts, and quotations must also follow workplace policies and access rules.

The software does not classify content as work, personal, or anything else, and it does not judge the people nearby. Users choose the target windows, trigger, and actions, and should use them only for lawful personal privacy and information protection.
bullets: Brief cover: hide selected windows
Leaving or possible access: lock Windows
Important records: also follow organizational data rules

zh.title: 临时投屏或共享屏幕前，私人窗口来不及整理怎么办？
zh.description: 临时投屏、远程会议或共享 Windows 屏幕前，怎样快速收起私人窗口并减少误展示。
zh.shortAnswer: 能提前准备时优先只共享单个应用，并关闭通知；已经临时开始投屏时，可用预设动作隐藏不应展示的窗口。隐藏窗口只是应急措施，不能替代会前检查。

sections.heading: 先缩小共享范围，再准备应急动作
paragraphs: 会议软件允许时，只共享需要演示的应用，而不是整个桌面；同时检查桌面、任务栏、浏览器标签页和通知预览。共享前先做一次预览，通常比临场补救可靠。
如果会议临时开始，可触发隐藏事先选定的私人窗口，再确认共享画面。软件不会自动理解哪个窗口适合公开，目标窗口和保护动作需要由用户自行设置。
bullets: 优先共享单个应用
关闭消息和邮件通知预览
共享前检查实际输出画面

en.title: What if I have no time to organize private windows before screen sharing?
en.description: Quickly cover private windows and reduce accidental exposure before presenting or sharing a Windows screen.
en.shortAnswer: When possible, share one application and disable notifications. If an ad-hoc presentation has already started, use a configured action to hide windows that should not be shown. This is a fallback, not a replacement for a pre-meeting check.

sections.heading: Limit the shared area before relying on an emergency action
paragraphs: Share only the presentation application rather than the full desktop when the meeting tool allows it. Check the desktop, taskbar, browser tabs, and notification previews, then preview the output before others join.

For an unexpected meeting, hide previously selected private windows and verify the shared view. The software cannot infer which window is appropriate to show; users choose the target windows and protection actions.
bullets: Prefer sharing one application
Disable message and email previews
Check the actual shared output

zh.title: 在家、宿舍或公共场所用电脑，怎样避免私人内容突然被看到？
zh.description: 在家庭、宿舍、共享空间和公共场所使用 Windows 电脑时，怎样减少私人内容被旁人突然看到。
zh.shortAnswer: 把屏幕摆放、通知隐藏和 Windows 锁屏作为基础，再准备一个熟悉的快速触发。多人环境中不要只依赖临时关窗口，离开设备时应锁屏。

sections.heading: 环境习惯比单个动作更重要
paragraphs: 先调整屏幕角度，关闭锁屏和桌面上的敏感通知预览，并为不同使用者准备独立的 Windows 账户。宿舍和公共空间人员流动较多，短暂离开也应锁定电脑。
快速隐藏可以处理有人突然靠近的瞬间，但电脑仍可能处于可操作状态。私人文件应放在合适的受保护位置，并遵守所在场所和设备的使用规定。
bullets: 关闭敏感通知预览
离开座位就锁定 Windows
共享电脑使用独立账户

en.title: How can I stop private content being seen at home, in a dorm, or in public?
en.description: Reduce accidental viewing of private content when using a Windows PC at home, in a dorm, shared space, or public place.
en.shortAnswer: Start with screen placement, hidden notification previews, and Windows lock, then prepare one familiar quick trigger. In shared environments, do not rely only on closing a window; lock the PC whenever you step away.

sections.heading: Everyday environment habits matter more than one action
paragraphs: Adjust the screen angle, remove sensitive previews from the lock screen and desktop, and use separate Windows accounts for different people. In dorms and public spaces, lock the computer even for a short absence.
Quick hiding can cover the moment when someone approaches, but the PC may remain usable. Store private files in an appropriate protected location and follow the rules of the device and location.
bullets: Disable sensitive notification previews
Lock Windows whenever you leave
Use separate accounts on a shared PC

zh.title: 玩游戏、看视频或处理私人内容时，有人突然靠近怎么办？
zh.description: 玩游戏、看视频或查看私人内容时有人突然靠近，怎样快速遮挡 Windows 屏幕并减少误操作。
zh.shortAnswer: 先使用不会结束程序的隐藏或锁屏动作，避免为了遮挡内容而强制关闭游戏、播放器或文档。具体保护哪些内容由用户决定，软件不评价内容类型。

sections.heading: 优先选择可恢复的处理方式
paragraphs: 全屏游戏和视频可能会占用快捷键或改变窗口切换行为，应提前确认触发在常用程序中是否有效。只想短暂遮挡时可隐藏目标窗口；对方可能使用电脑时直接锁屏更稳妥。
不要把普通娱乐、私人通信或工作内容固定成某种标签。超级看门狗只执行用户配置的触发和动作，不判断用户为什么需要隐私；使用时应尊重他人权益并遵守法律。
bullets: 在常用全屏程序中提前试用
避免强制结束未保存内容
可能有人操作电脑时使用锁屏

en.title: What should I do if someone approaches while I am gaming or viewing private content?
en.description: Cover a Windows screen quickly and avoid mistakes when someone approaches during a game, video, or other private activity.
en.shortAnswer: Use hiding or Windows lock without terminating applications, rather than force-closing a game, player, or document. Users decide what to protect; the software does not evaluate the type of content.

sections.heading: Prefer an action that is easy to recover from
paragraphs: Full-screen games and video can capture shortcuts or change window switching, so test the trigger with applications you actually use. Hide a selected window for brief cover, or lock Windows if someone may use the PC.

Entertainment, private communication, and work do not need to be forced into a label. SuperWatchDog executes the user's configured trigger and actions without judging why privacy is needed. Use it lawfully and respect the rights of others.
bullets: Test with commonly used full-screen applications
Avoid force-closing unsaved content
Use Windows lock if someone may touch the PC

zh.title: Win+L 和超级看门狗有什么区别？
zh.description: 比较 Win+L 锁定 Windows 与超级看门狗的自定义触发和保护动作，判断紧急隐私场景怎样选择。
zh.shortAnswer: Win+L 是 Windows 自带且直接的锁屏快捷键，适合手能碰到键盘时立即阻止他人使用当前会话。超级看门狗解决的是用户希望用其他触发方式，并按自己的选择组合窗口、锁屏和保险箱动作的场景。

sections.heading: Win+L 是基础，扩展触发解决够不到键盘的问题
paragraphs: 如果手就在键盘旁，Win+L 通常已经足够快，而且无需额外配置。它会锁定当前 Windows 会话，但不会替用户决定哪些窗口要处理，也不等于锁定仍处于打开状态的私密文件容器。
超级看门狗可让用户预先选择快捷键、设备或摄像头触发，并决定执行隐藏窗口、锁屏或保险箱保护等动作。它不是 Win+L 的强制替代品，选择取决于距离、环境和用户愿意承担的影响。
bullets: 能碰到键盘：优先记住 Win+L
需要免接触或设备触发：提前配置并试用
文件保护：单独确认保险箱状态

en.title: What is the difference between Win+L and SuperWatchDog?
en.description: Compare the built-in Win+L Windows lock with SuperWatchDog triggers and user-selected protection actions.
en.shortAnswer: Win+L is the direct built-in shortcut for locking Windows and works well when you can reach the keyboard. SuperWatchDog is for users who want other trigger methods and their own combination of window, lock-screen, and vault actions.

sections.heading: Win+L is the baseline; alternative triggers help beyond keyboard reach
paragraphs: When your hand is near the keyboard, Win+L is often fast enough and needs no extra setup. It locks the current Windows session, but does not decide which windows to handle or necessarily lock a private file container that remains open.

SuperWatchDog lets users configure a shortcut, device, or camera trigger and choose actions such as hiding windows, locking Windows, or protecting a vault. It is not a mandatory replacement for Win+L; the right choice depends on distance, environment, and acceptable impact.
bullets: At the keyboard: remember Win+L
For touch-free or device triggers: configure and test first
For files: verify the vault state separately

zh.title: Alt+Tab 或直接关窗口，为什么不一定能解决紧急隐私问题？
zh.description: 说明 Alt+Tab、最小化和关闭窗口在有人突然靠近时的用途，以及它们不能覆盖的紧急隐私场景。
zh.shortAnswer: 只有一个窗口且手能操作时，切换或关闭当然可用；窗口较多、全屏程序占用按键、文件未保存或他人可能继续操作电脑时，这些方法就不够稳定。

sections.heading: 临时切换窗口不等于完成保护
paragraphs: Alt+Tab 可能显示窗口缩略图，直接关闭可能触发保存提示或丢失未保存内容，最小化后窗口也仍可从任务栏重新打开。它们适合有时间处理单个窗口的情况，不适合假设所有紧急场景都一样。
预设触发的价值是把用户已经决定的窗口和动作一次执行；如果他人可能触碰电脑，仍应锁定 Windows。软件不会扫描内容并自动替用户选择要隐藏什么。
bullets: 单个窗口且有时间：手动切换或关闭即可
多个目标窗口：提前设置并验证
需要阻止继续操作：锁定 Windows

en.title: Why do Alt+Tab or closing a window not solve every privacy emergency?
en.description: Understand when Alt+Tab, minimizing, and closing windows help and what urgent privacy situations they do not cover.
en.shortAnswer: Switching or closing can work for one window when your hands are free. It is less dependable with many windows, full-screen shortcuts, unsaved files, or a person who may continue using the PC.

sections.heading: Switching one window is not the same as completing protection
paragraphs: Alt+Tab can reveal window previews, closing may show a save prompt or lose unsaved work, and minimized windows can be reopened from the taskbar. These methods suit a single window when there is time, not every urgent situation.

A configured trigger executes the windows and actions that the user already selected. Lock Windows if someone may touch the PC. The software does not scan content and choose what to hide on the user's behalf.
bullets: One window and enough time: switch or close manually
Several target windows: configure and verify first
Prevent further use: lock Windows

zh.title: 老板键和超级看门狗有什么区别？
zh.description: 比较传统老板键的窗口隐藏方式与超级看门狗的用户自定义触发、锁屏和文件保护动作。
zh.shortAnswer: 传统老板键通常用于按键后隐藏或恢复特定窗口；超级看门狗允许用户选择更多触发方式，并自行组合窗口处理、Windows 锁屏和保险箱保护。两者都不判断内容，使用时仍需遵守单位制度。

sections.heading: 区别在触发范围和动作层级
paragraphs: 老板键适合人在键盘前快速隐藏窗口，优点是路径简单；它通常不会阻止别人继续操作电脑，也不保护磁盘上的文件。不同软件对老板键的实现可能不同，应以实际行为为准。
超级看门狗面向更广的紧急隐私场景，用户可以选择快捷键、设备或摄像头触发，再决定执行哪些保护动作。它不评价或识别内容，使用者仍需遵守法律、工作制度和设备管理要求。
bullets: 只需隐藏窗口：老板键可能已经够用
需要其他触发或锁屏：提前配置相应动作
需要保护文件：使用独立的文件保护方案

en.title: What is the difference between a boss key and SuperWatchDog?
en.description: Compare traditional boss-key window hiding with SuperWatchDog user-selected triggers, Windows lock, and file protection actions.
en.shortAnswer: A traditional boss key usually hides and restores selected windows with a keystroke. SuperWatchDog offers more trigger choices and lets users combine window handling, Windows lock, and vault protection. Neither judges content or overrides workplace rules.

sections.heading: The difference is the trigger range and action layers
paragraphs: A boss key is useful for quickly hiding a window while at the keyboard. It normally does not prevent someone from using the PC or protect files on disk, although behavior varies by application.

SuperWatchDog covers broader emergency privacy situations: users select a shortcut, device, or camera trigger and then choose the protection actions. It does not evaluate or identify content, and users must still follow the law, workplace policies, and device-management rules.
bullets: Only hiding windows: a boss key may be enough
Other triggers or Windows lock: configure the relevant actions
Protecting files: use a separate file-protection layer

zh.title: 文件加密和紧急隐私保护有什么区别？
zh.description: 比较文件加密与紧急屏幕隐私保护，理解它们分别解决存储访问和突发旁观问题。
zh.shortAnswer: 文件加密主要保护未解锁状态下的存储数据，紧急隐私保护主要处理当前屏幕、登录会话和已打开窗口。两者互补，任何一项都不能自动代替另一项。

sections.heading: 一个保护存储，一个处理正在发生的现场
paragraphs: 加密文件如果已经解锁并显示在屏幕上，旁边的人仍可能看到；快速隐藏或锁屏可以遮挡当前内容，却不会把普通文件自动变成加密存储。因此应按风险分别准备。
需要长期保存的私人文件可放入受保护的保险箱，并在不用时锁定；有人突然靠近时，再使用合适的窗口或锁屏动作。用户自行决定保护对象和时机，软件不判断文件内容。
bullets: 存储访问：依靠合适的文件加密
当前屏幕：依靠隐藏窗口或锁屏
离开电脑：同时检查会话和保险箱状态

en.title: What is the difference between file encryption and emergency privacy protection?
en.description: Compare file encryption with emergency screen privacy and separate storage access from sudden shoulder-surfing risks.
en.shortAnswer: File encryption mainly protects stored data while it is locked. Emergency privacy protection handles the current screen, signed-in session, and open windows. They complement each other; neither automatically replaces the other.

sections.heading: One protects storage; the other handles the live situation
paragraphs: If an encrypted file is already unlocked and visible, a nearby person can still see it. Hiding or locking the screen covers current content but does not turn ordinary files into encrypted storage. Prepare each layer for its own risk.

Keep long-term private files in an appropriate protected vault and lock it when not in use. When someone approaches, use a suitable window or Windows-lock action. Users choose what and when to protect; the software does not judge file contents.
bullets: Stored data access: use suitable file encryption
Current screen: hide windows or lock Windows
Leaving the PC: check both session and vault state

related.en: Emergency protection for the current screen

zh.title: 快捷键、U 盘、蓝牙和摄像头触发，应该怎样选？
zh.description: 按距离、可靠性和环境条件选择 Windows 紧急隐私保护触发方式。
zh.shortAnswer: 人在电脑前首选快捷键；能随手带走设备可选 U 盘；随身设备会和人一起离开可考虑蓝牙；仍在镜头前但手不方便时可用手势。

sections.heading: 先确定最常见的真实场景
paragraphs: 触发方式不是越多越好。快捷键路径最短，适合作为基础；设备和摄像头触发解决的是手够不到电脑或已经离开的情况，但会增加环境变量。
建议先配置一个手动方式和一个最符合日常习惯的自动方式。连续使用一段时间，确认没有漏触发或误触发后，再考虑增加其他方式。
bullets: 电脑前：快捷键
带走实物设备：U 盘
人与随身设备离开：蓝牙
镜头范围内免接触：手势

en.title: Should I use a shortcut, USB, Bluetooth, or a camera trigger?
en.description: Choose an emergency privacy trigger by distance, reliability, and environment.
en.shortAnswer: Use a shortcut while at the PC, USB when you can take a device with you, Bluetooth when a personal device leaves with you, and a gesture when you remain in view but cannot use your hands.

sections.heading: Start with your most common real situation
paragraphs: More triggers are not automatically better. A shortcut has the shortest path and makes a good baseline. Device and camera triggers help when the PC is out of reach, but introduce more environmental variables.
Configure one manual method and one automatic method that fits your routine. Use them for a while and check for missed or false triggers before adding another.
bullets: At the PC: shortcut
Taking a physical device: USB
Leaving with a personal device: Bluetooth
Hands-free while visible: gesture

zh.title: 快捷键和摄像头手势，哪一种更适合紧急触发？
zh.description: 比较键盘快捷键与摄像头手势在紧急隐私保护中的可靠性和使用条件。
zh.shortAnswer: 能碰到键盘时优先快捷键；手被占用、键盘较远但人仍在镜头范围时，手势更有价值。两者可以互为备用，但都应提前练习。

sections.heading: 可靠性来自匹配场景
paragraphs: 快捷键不依赖光线和镜头视野，通常更可预测，但要求您能迅速碰到键盘并记住按键。手势不需要接触设备，却会受到光线、遮挡、站位和摄像头状态影响。
不要把复杂动作链绑定到尚未熟悉的手势。先使用隐藏窗口或锁屏等容易恢复的结果，确认识别稳定后再日常使用。
bullets: 快捷键适合近距离
手势适合免接触但仍可见
始终保留另一种手动退出方式

en.title: Which is better for urgent triggering: a shortcut or a camera gesture?
en.description: Compare keyboard shortcuts and camera gestures for emergency privacy protection.
en.shortAnswer: Prefer a shortcut when the keyboard is within reach. A gesture is useful when your hands are occupied or the keyboard is farther away while you remain in camera view. Practice both before relying on them.

sections.heading: Reliability comes from matching the situation
paragraphs: A shortcut does not depend on lighting or camera view and is usually more predictable, but you must reach the keyboard and remember the keys. A gesture is touch-free but depends on lighting, occlusion, position, and camera availability.
Do not bind a complex action chain to an unfamiliar gesture. Start with a reversible result such as hiding windows or locking Windows, then use it routinely after recognition is stable.
bullets: Shortcuts suit close range
Gestures suit touch-free use while visible
Keep another manual way to recover

zh.title: 拔出 U 盘触发保护，适合什么场景？
zh.description: 了解 U 盘拔出触发 Windows 隐私保护的适用场景、准备方法和限制。
zh.shortAnswer: 它适合把指定 U 盘当作随身触发物的人：离开时拔走设备即可执行预设保护。它不是 U 盘文件加密，也不代表任何 U 盘拔出都会触发。

sections.heading: 把设备和行为绑定
paragraphs: 选择一个稳定、不会经常用于传输文件的 U 盘作为可信设备。日常离开时把它带走，可以形成明确动作，比依赖记忆点击按钮更自然。
突然松动、接口供电或集线器问题也可能表现为设备断开。重要工作中应避免把高影响动作直接绑定到 U 盘拔出，并定期确认指定设备仍能被识别。
bullets: 使用专门且稳定的设备
不要在写入 U 盘时直接拔出
默认先绑定锁屏等低影响动作

en.title: When is USB removal a useful privacy trigger?
en.description: Understand suitable scenarios, preparation, and limitations for USB-removal privacy triggers.
en.shortAnswer: It suits people who use one designated USB device as a physical trigger: take it when leaving to run the selected protection. It does not encrypt files on that USB device, and removing an arbitrary USB device does not trigger protection.

sections.heading: Bind a device to a routine
paragraphs: Choose a stable USB device that is not frequently used for file transfer. Taking it whenever you leave creates a clear physical habit and can be easier than remembering to click a button.

Loose connections, power issues, and hubs may also look like removal. Avoid binding disruptive actions directly to USB removal during important work, and periodically confirm that the designated device is still recognized.
bullets: Use a dedicated, stable device
Do not remove it while data is being written
Start with a low-impact action such as Windows lock

related.zh: 设备触发保护的完整说明

zh.title: 蓝牙设备断开触发保护，怎样减少误触发？
zh.description: 配置蓝牙断开隐私保护时，通过设备选择、延迟和动作分层减少误触发。
zh.shortAnswer: 选择连接稳定、确实随人离开的设备，给短暂波动留出确认时间，并先绑定锁屏等可恢复动作；不要用偶尔休眠的耳机直接触发重启或关机。

sections.heading: 蓝牙断开不一定等于人已离开
paragraphs: 耳机省电、手机系统限制、无线干扰和距离变化都可能造成短暂断连。先观察设备在办公环境中的连接表现，再决定它是否适合作为触发依据。
如果环境经常波动，应增加合理延迟或改用 U 盘、快捷键。触发记录可以帮助区分真实离开与连接不稳定，但不要为了追求灵敏而牺牲日常工作的可用性。
bullets: 优先选择稳定且随身的设备
允许短暂断连恢复
误触发期间不要启用高影响动作

en.title: How can I reduce false triggers from Bluetooth disconnects?
en.description: Reduce Bluetooth false triggers through device choice, confirmation delay, and layered actions.
en.shortAnswer: Choose a stable device that actually leaves with you, allow time for brief connection drops, and start with a reversible action such as Windows lock. Do not let occasionally sleeping headphones directly restart or shut down the PC.

sections.heading: A disconnect does not always mean you left
paragraphs: Headphone power saving, phone restrictions, radio interference, and distance changes can all cause a brief disconnect. Observe the device in your normal environment before treating it as a reliable presence signal.

If the environment is unstable, use a reasonable delay or switch to USB or a shortcut. Trigger history can help distinguish leaving from connection trouble, but responsiveness should not make everyday work unreliable.
bullets: Prefer a stable device that stays with you
Allow brief disconnects to recover
Keep high-impact actions disabled while tuning

zh.title: 摄像头手势和离席检测有什么区别？
zh.description: 区分主动摄像头手势与自动离席检测在 Windows 隐私保护中的用途。
zh.shortAnswer: 手势是您主动发出明确指令，适合人在镜头前；离席检测根据持续无人状态自动执行，适合忘记手动保护，但需要更保守的时间设置。

sections.heading: 主动信号与自动判断
paragraphs: 手势由您决定触发时机，通常更符合紧急场景。离席检测减少了遗忘，但它只能根据画面状态判断，并不知道您是否只是短暂侧身、被遮挡或仍在附近。
两类摄像头能力默认关闭。启用后先确认镜头范围、光线和等待时间，自动离席只绑定锁屏等低影响动作更稳妥。
bullets: 需要即时决定：手势
担心忘记保护：离席检测
环境不稳定：使用快捷键或设备触发

en.title: What is the difference between a camera gesture and away detection?
en.description: Distinguish an intentional camera gesture from automatic away detection for Windows privacy.
en.shortAnswer: A gesture is an explicit command while you are in view. Away detection acts after continued absence and helps when you forget, but it needs more conservative timing.

sections.heading: Intentional signal versus automatic judgment
paragraphs: You choose the moment for a gesture, which often fits urgent situations better. Away detection reduces reliance on memory, but it sees only the camera state and cannot know whether you briefly turned, were occluded, or remain nearby.
Both camera features are disabled by default. After enabling one, check camera view, lighting, and timing. It is safer to bind automatic away detection to a low-impact action such as Windows lock.
bullets: Need an immediate decision: gesture
Concerned about forgetting: away detection
Unstable environment: shortcut or device trigger

zh.title: 把电脑临时借给别人前，怎样保护私人文件和账号？
zh.description: 临时把 Windows 电脑借给家人、同事或朋友前，怎样保护私人文件、浏览器账号和当前登录会话。
zh.shortAnswer: 优先给对方使用独立的 Windows 账户或访客环境，退出不需要共享的账号，并锁定私人文件保险箱。不要只把文件拖到另一个文件夹或临时隐藏窗口。

sections.heading: 借用前先划清账户和文件边界
paragraphs: 检查浏览器同步、邮件、聊天软件、云盘、桌面和下载目录，关闭自动填充与敏感通知预览。条件允许时，新建权限受限的本地账户，让借用者不进入您的日常登录会话。
需要保留在电脑上的私人文件应使用合适的加密保护，并确认保险箱已锁定。超级看门狗可以执行用户选择的保护动作，但不会自动识别哪些文件或账号属于隐私。
bullets: 使用独立且受限的 Windows 账户
退出无需共享的应用和网页账号
锁定保险箱并保留重要资料备份

en.title: How should I protect private files and accounts before lending my PC?
en.description: Protect private files, browser accounts, and the signed-in Windows session before lending a PC to family, a colleague, or a friend.
en.shortAnswer: Give the borrower a separate Windows account or guest environment, sign out of accounts they do not need, and lock the private-file vault. Do not rely only on moving files to another folder or hiding windows.

sections.heading: Separate accounts and files before lending
paragraphs: Review browser sync, email, chat, cloud storage, the desktop, and Downloads. Disable autofill and sensitive notification previews. When possible, create a restricted local account so the borrower does not enter your everyday session.

Use appropriate encryption for private files that remain on the PC and verify that the vault is locked. SuperWatchDog can run user-selected protection actions, but it does not automatically identify private files or accounts.
bullets: Use a separate restricted Windows account
Sign out of applications and web accounts that are not needed
Lock the vault and keep backups of important data

zh.title: 电脑送修前，怎样保护照片、账号和工作资料？
zh.description: Windows 电脑送修前，怎样备份并保护照片、浏览器账号、客户资料和合同等私人或工作数据。
zh.shortAnswer: 先完整备份，再退出账号并删除维修不需要的本地副本；必须留在设备上的私人资料应保持加密和锁定。能取下的数据盘应在确认维修不需要后妥善保管。

sections.heading: 送修保护要在交出电脑前完成
paragraphs: 记录故障和维修所需的测试条件，避免提供与维修无关的登录密码。退出浏览器、邮箱、聊天和云盘账号，检查桌面、下载目录、回收站及应用缓存；删除前先验证备份可以读取。
如果维修必须登录系统，可创建临时受限账户。客户资料、合同和单位数据还应遵守公司流程；不要仅依赖隐藏属性或改文件名。维修完成后，再检查账户登录和设备状态。
bullets: 先验证备份，再清理本地副本
不提供与维修无关的账号密码
使用临时受限账户或移除不必要的数据盘

en.title: How can I protect photos, accounts, and work files before PC repair?
en.description: Back up and protect photos, browser accounts, client records, contracts, and other private or work data before Windows PC repair.
en.shortAnswer: Make and verify a full backup, sign out of accounts, and remove local copies that are not needed for the repair. Keep any private data left on the device encrypted and locked, and remove data drives when the repair does not require them.

sections.heading: Finish privacy preparation before handing over the PC
paragraphs: Document the fault and the access needed for testing without giving unrelated sign-in passwords. Sign out of browsers, email, chat, and cloud storage, then review the desktop, Downloads, Recycle Bin, and application caches. Verify backups before deleting anything.

Create a temporary restricted account if repair staff must sign in. Follow organizational procedures for client records, contracts, and company data; hidden attributes and renamed files are not protection. Review account and device status after the repair.
bullets: Verify backups before removing local copies
Do not provide unrelated account passwords
Use a temporary restricted account or remove unnecessary data drives

zh.title: 客户资料、合同和报价单，怎样兼顾日常使用和隐私保护？
zh.description: 在 Windows 电脑上日常使用客户资料、合同和报价单时，怎样减少旁观、误传和未授权访问。
zh.shortAnswer: 按单位制度控制访问权限和保存位置，日常使用时减少通知、预览和共享范围，离开电脑时锁屏，并对允许本地保存的敏感文件使用合适的加密保护。

sections.heading: 紧急遮挡不能代替资料管理
paragraphs: 先确认资料是否允许下载到本地、谁有权访问、应保存多久以及怎样备份。投屏或共享屏幕时只共享必要应用，关闭邮件和聊天通知，避免文件名、客户名称或合同金额出现在预览中。
有人靠近时可按用户预设隐藏窗口或锁定 Windows，但这只能处理现场风险。长期保护仍依赖访问权限、加密、备份和单位流程；软件不会读取资料并判断其敏感级别。
bullets: 遵守客户和单位的数据管理要求
共享屏幕时缩小可见范围
离开座位时锁屏并锁定不再使用的保险箱

en.title: How can I use client records, contracts, and quotes while protecting privacy?
en.description: Reduce shoulder surfing, accidental sharing, and unauthorized access while using client records, contracts, and quotations on Windows.
en.shortAnswer: Follow organizational rules for access and storage, reduce notifications, previews, and sharing scope during use, lock Windows when leaving, and use appropriate encryption for sensitive files that may be stored locally.

sections.heading: Emergency screen cover does not replace information governance
paragraphs: Confirm whether the records may be downloaded, who may access them, how long they should be retained, and how they are backed up. Share only the necessary application during a presentation and disable email and chat notifications so filenames, client names, and contract amounts do not appear in previews.

A configured action can hide windows or lock Windows when someone approaches, but that addresses only the immediate scene. Long-term protection still relies on permissions, encryption, backups, and organizational processes. The software does not read records and classify their sensitivity.
bullets: Follow client and organizational data rules
Limit visible content while screen sharing
Lock Windows and any unused vault when leaving

zh.title: 隐藏屏幕内容，为什么不能代替私密文件保护？
zh.description: 理解屏幕遮挡、Windows 锁屏与 BitLocker 保险箱保护的是不同层面。
zh.shortAnswer: 隐藏窗口只改变当下看到的内容，文件仍可能存在于磁盘和最近记录中；私密文件需要单独放入受 BitLocker 保护的保险箱，并在不用时锁定。

sections.heading: 屏幕隐私与文件隐私是两层
paragraphs: 窗口隐藏适合处理突然有人看向屏幕的瞬间，Windows 锁屏用于阻止继续操作当前会话。它们不会自动把已经存放在普通文件夹中的文件迁移或加密。
保险箱更适合照片、证件扫描件和工作资料等长期敏感内容。打开时它会像磁盘一样供应用使用；离开前保存并关闭文件，再锁定保险箱。
bullets: 屏幕层：隐藏或锁屏
存储层：加密保险箱
日常层：减少普通目录中的副本和导出文件

en.title: Why does hiding the screen not replace private file protection?
en.description: Understand how visual cover, Windows lock, and a BitLocker vault protect different layers.
en.shortAnswer: Hiding windows changes only what is visible now; files may still remain on storage or in recent history. Sensitive files need their own BitLocker-protected vault, locked when not in use.

sections.heading: Screen privacy and file privacy are separate layers
paragraphs: Window hiding handles the instant someone looks at the screen, while Windows lock prevents use of the current session. Neither automatically moves or encrypts files already stored in normal folders.

A vault is more suitable for long-term sensitive content such as photos, identity scans, and work documents. While open, it is available to applications like a drive; save and close files before locking it.
bullets: Screen layer: hide or lock
Storage layer: encrypted vault
Daily practice: reduce copies and exports in ordinary folders

related.en: File privacy on a shared PC

zh.title: 照片、证件扫描件和合同，应该怎样存放？
zh.description: 在 Windows 电脑上分层管理照片、证件扫描件、合同等敏感文件。
zh.shortAnswer: 把需要长期保密的原件集中放入加密保险箱，普通目录只保留确实需要的副本；使用结束后关闭文件并锁定保险箱，同时单独保管恢复材料。

sections.heading: 先减少散落副本
paragraphs: 敏感文件常从下载目录、聊天软件和扫描工具产生。移动到保险箱后，还要检查是否在桌面、最近导出位置或同步目录留下副本。
保险箱不是备份。重要资料仍需要符合您安全要求的独立备份，密码和恢复材料也不要与保险箱文件放在同一位置。
bullets: 集中原件，减少普通目录副本
关闭预览和编辑程序后再锁定
为重要资料准备独立备份

en.title: How should I store photos, identity scans, and contracts?
en.description: Use layered storage for sensitive photos, identity scans, and contracts on Windows.
en.shortAnswer: Keep long-term sensitive originals together in an encrypted vault and retain only necessary copies in normal folders. Close files and lock the vault after use, and store recovery material separately.

sections.heading: Reduce scattered copies first
paragraphs: Sensitive files often originate in Downloads, messaging applications, and scanning tools. After moving them into the vault, check whether copies remain on the desktop, in recent export locations, or in synchronized folders.
A vault is not a backup. Important material still needs an independent backup that meets your security needs, and passwords or recovery material should not be stored beside the vault file.
bullets: Centralize originals and reduce normal-folder copies
Close viewers and editors before locking
Maintain an independent backup for important material

zh.title: 电脑借给别人或送修前，应该检查什么？
zh.description: Windows 电脑临时借用或送修前的隐私文件、账号和保险箱检查清单。
zh.shortAnswer: 先保存工作并锁定保险箱，确认敏感文件没有散落在桌面、下载和同步目录，再退出不需要暴露的账号；送修仍应按最小数据原则准备。

sections.heading: 不要只关闭窗口
paragraphs: 借机和送修时间更长，对方可能有充分时间浏览普通目录。应先检查文件副本、浏览器下载、聊天软件缓存和云同步状态，再确认保险箱处于锁定状态。
如果维修不需要原系统数据，优先使用厂商建议的数据备份与送修方案。无法移除的数据应有可恢复备份，且不要向无关人员提供保险箱密码或恢复材料。
bullets: 保存并关闭正在使用的敏感文件
锁定保险箱并退出敏感账号
备份重要资料，遵循最小数据原则

en.title: What should I check before lending or repairing my PC?
en.description: A privacy checklist for files, accounts, and vaults before lending or repairing a Windows PC.
en.shortAnswer: Save work and lock the vault, check that sensitive files are not scattered across Desktop, Downloads, or sync folders, and sign out of accounts that need not be exposed. Prepare repairs using data minimization.

sections.heading: Do more than close windows
paragraphs: A borrower or technician may have plenty of time to browse normal folders. Check file copies, browser downloads, messaging caches, and cloud synchronization, then confirm the vault is locked.

If repair does not require your original data, follow the manufacturer's recommended backup and service preparation. Maintain recoverable backups for data that remains, and do not give unrelated people the vault password or recovery material.
bullets: Save and close sensitive files in use
Lock the vault and sign out of sensitive accounts
Back up important data and minimize what remains

zh.title: 有可信设备，为什么打开保险箱还要输入密码？
zh.description: 解释可信设备与 BitLocker 密码在保险箱访问中的不同作用。
zh.shortAnswer: 可信设备只是判断是否允许进入打开流程的条件，不是保险箱密码。设备在场后仍需输入 BitLocker 密码，避免仅拿到设备就能直接读取文件。

sections.heading: 设备和密码各自证明一部分条件
paragraphs: 可信设备适合表达“这个设备是否在场”，密码用于解锁加密保险箱。把两者分开，可以降低设备遗失或被临时拿走时直接暴露文件的风险。
不要把密码保存在电脑上的普通文档、脚本或备注中。恢复材料用于忘记密码等恢复场景，应放在与电脑和保险箱文件分离的安全位置。
bullets: 可信设备不保存或替代密码
打开时由用户输入密码
恢复材料与保险箱分开保管

en.title: Why is a password still required when a trusted device is present?
en.description: Understand the different roles of a trusted device and a BitLocker password in vault access.
en.shortAnswer: A trusted device is only a condition for entering the open flow; it is not the vault password. You still enter the BitLocker password so possession of the device alone does not reveal files.

sections.heading: The device and password prove different conditions
paragraphs: A trusted device indicates that a selected device is present, while the password unlocks the encrypted vault. Keeping them separate reduces exposure if the device is lost or briefly taken.
Do not store the password in an ordinary document, script, or note on the PC. Recovery material is for recovery scenarios and should be kept somewhere separate from both the computer and vault file.
bullets: A trusted device does not store or replace the password
The user enters the password when opening
Keep recovery material separate from the vault

zh.title: 支持哪些 Windows 版本？家庭版能用吗？
zh.description: SuperWatchDog 1.0.0 的 Windows 版本、系统架构和 BitLocker 功能条件。
zh.shortAnswer: 1.0.0 面向 Windows 10/11 64 位系统，推荐专业版、企业版或教育版。家庭版可使用基础触发与锁屏能力，但通常无法使用依赖系统 BitLocker 的保险箱创建与保护。

sections.heading: 先区分基础保护与保险箱
paragraphs: 快捷触发、窗口处理和 Windows 锁屏属于基础保护。加密保险箱依赖系统提供的 BitLocker 能力，因此实际可用性取决于 Windows 版本和设备配置。
Windows 7、8 和 8.1 不在支持范围内。安装或购买前先查看系统版本与架构；如果目标是使用保险箱，还应确认系统能够使用 BitLocker。
bullets: 支持：Windows 10/11 64 位
推荐：专业版、企业版、教育版
家庭版：以基础触发和锁屏能力为主

en.title: Which Windows versions are supported, and does Home edition work?
en.description: Windows version, architecture, and BitLocker requirements for SuperWatchDog 1.0.0.
en.shortAnswer: Version 1.0.0 targets 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, with Pro, Enterprise, or Education recommended. Home can use basic triggers and Windows lock, but normally cannot use vault creation and protection that depend on system BitLocker.

sections.heading: Separate basic protection from the vault
paragraphs: Quick triggers, window handling, and Windows lock are basic protection. The encrypted vault depends on BitLocker supplied by Windows, so availability varies with the Windows edition and device configuration.
Windows 7, 8, and 8.1 are not supported. Check the Windows edition and architecture before installing or buying; if the vault is your goal, also confirm that BitLocker is available.
bullets: Supported: 64-bit Windows 10 and 11
Recommended: Pro, Enterprise, or Education
Home: primarily basic triggers and Windows lock

zh.title: 系统没有可用的 BitLocker，还能做什么？
zh.description: Windows 缺少 BitLocker 时可使用的基础隐私保护能力和不能使用的保险箱能力。
zh.shortAnswer: 仍可使用快捷键、设备或摄像头触发的基础窗口与锁屏保护，但不能创建或依赖 BitLocker 保险箱来保护私密文件。

sections.heading: 不要把基础锁屏当作文件加密
paragraphs: 基础保护能减少他人直接看到屏幕或继续操作当前会话的机会，适合突发场景。它不会把普通文件夹变成加密存储，也不会补充系统缺少的 BitLocker 功能。
如果保险箱是主要需求，应升级到具备 BitLocker 的受支持 Windows 版本或选择符合自身安全要求的其他加密方案。不要使用来源不明的系统修改工具强行开启功能。
bullets: 可用：触发、隐藏窗口、Windows 锁屏
不可用：BitLocker 保险箱创建与锁定保护
先确认系统版本再决定方案

en.title: What can I do when BitLocker is unavailable?
en.description: Basic privacy features available without BitLocker and vault features that are not available.
en.shortAnswer: You can still use shortcut, device, or camera triggers for basic window and Windows-lock protection, but you cannot create or rely on a BitLocker vault for sensitive files.

sections.heading: Do not treat basic locking as file encryption
paragraphs: Basic protection reduces the chance of someone immediately seeing the screen or using the current session. It does not turn an ordinary folder into encrypted storage or supply BitLocker when Windows lacks it.

If the vault is your main requirement, upgrade to a supported Windows edition with BitLocker or choose another encryption solution that meets your needs. Avoid unknown system modification tools that claim to force unsupported features on.
bullets: Available: triggers, window hiding, Windows lock
Unavailable: BitLocker vault creation and locking
Confirm the Windows edition before choosing a solution

zh.title: 保护 Windows 私密文件，为什么优先用 BitLocker 而不是自己写加密？
zh.description: 解释 Windows 私密文件保护为什么优先采用 BitLocker，而不是自行设计磁盘加密格式和密钥系统。
zh.shortAnswer: 因为可靠的磁盘加密不只是选择一种算法，还要长期处理密钥、磁盘格式、异常断电、系统更新和数据恢复。优先复用 Windows 提供的 BitLocker，通常比自行设计整套加密系统更容易验证和维护。

sections.heading: 真正困难的是完整生命周期
paragraphs: 自行实现加密时，算法只是很小的一部分。还要保证密钥生成和保存方式合理、磁盘读写一致、异常断电后仍可恢复，并持续适配 Windows 更新、驱动和存储设备变化。任何一个环节处理不当，都可能让数据无法打开或失去预期保护。
BitLocker 是 Windows 提供的卷加密能力，具备成熟的系统集成和恢复机制。采用它不代表加密绝对不会出问题，也不能替代备份、强密码和恢复材料保管；它的价值是减少自建加密格式和密钥体系带来的额外风险。
bullets: 加密安全取决于算法之外的密钥与恢复流程
系统更新和异常断电也必须纳入设计
重要文件仍需独立备份
密码与恢复材料应分别妥善保管

sections.heading: 紧急保护和文件加密解决不同问题
paragraphs: BitLocker 保护的是存储中的文件数据；锁屏、收起窗口或设备触发处理的是有人突然靠近、临时投屏或离开电脑时的即时暴露。两者不能互相替代。
超级看门狗组合使用 Windows 的 BitLocker 能力和用户自行选择的紧急保护动作。软件不判断用户要保护什么内容，用户应只在合法合规的个人隐私、办公资料和客户资料保护场景中使用，并自行决定保护内容、触发方式和动作。
bullets: 文件加密负责长期存储保护
紧急动作负责减少当前内容暴露
由用户决定保护对象和执行动作

en.title: Why use BitLocker instead of writing custom encryption for private Windows files?
en.description: Why private file protection on Windows favors BitLocker over a custom disk format and key system.
en.shortAnswer: Reliable disk encryption involves much more than choosing an algorithm. It must handle keys, disk formats, power loss, Windows updates, and recovery for years. Reusing Windows BitLocker is generally easier to validate and maintain than designing an entire encryption system.

sections.heading: The full lifecycle is the difficult part
paragraphs: The algorithm is only a small part of custom encryption. A design must also generate and protect keys, keep disk writes consistent, recover after power loss, and remain compatible with Windows updates, drivers, and changing storage devices. A mistake in any layer can make data inaccessible or undermine the expected protection.

BitLocker provides volume encryption integrated with Windows and includes established recovery mechanisms. This does not make failures impossible or replace backups, strong passwords, and careful recovery-key storage. It reduces the extra risk of inventing a new encrypted format and key system.
bullets: Security depends on key and recovery handling as well as the algorithm
Windows updates and power loss belong in the threat model
Keep an independent backup of important files
Store passwords and recovery material carefully and separately

sections.heading: Emergency privacy and file encryption solve different problems
paragraphs: BitLocker protects file data at rest. Windows lock, window handling, and device triggers address immediate exposure when someone approaches, a screen must be shared, or the user walks away. Neither replaces the other.

SuperWatchDog combines Windows BitLocker capabilities with emergency actions chosen by the user. The software does not decide what the user should protect. Users choose the content, trigger, and action and should use them only for lawful personal privacy, workplace records, and client-data protection.
bullets: File encryption protects long-term storage
Emergency actions reduce immediate on-screen exposure
The user chooses the protected content and actions

related.zh: Windows 文件保险箱怎样保护私密文件
related.en: How a Windows file vault protects private files

zh.title: 摄像头检测会保存或上传画面吗？
zh.description: SuperWatchDog 摄像头手势与离席检测的本地处理、默认状态和隐私边界。
zh.shortAnswer: 不会。摄像头检测在本机处理，不做人脸识别，不保存、录制或上传画面；相关功能默认关闭，只有用户主动开启后才使用。

sections.heading: 只在需要时启用
paragraphs: 手势和离席检测需要读取摄像头画面来判断动作或在场状态，但产品不把画面作为照片或视频保存，也不用于识别人是谁。
如果您不希望软件使用摄像头，保持相关功能关闭即可；快捷键、U 盘和蓝牙触发不依赖摄像头。还可以在 Windows 隐私设置中查看和管理摄像头权限。
bullets: 本机处理
不做人脸识别
不保存、录制或上传画面
功能默认关闭

en.title: Does camera detection save or upload images?
en.description: Local processing, default state, and privacy boundaries for camera gesture and away detection.
en.shortAnswer: No. Camera detection is processed locally, does not identify faces, and does not save, record, or upload images. Camera features are disabled by default and operate only after the user enables them.

sections.heading: Enable it only when needed
paragraphs: Gesture and away detection read camera frames to estimate an action or presence state, but the product does not retain those frames as photos or video and does not use them to identify who a person is.

If you do not want the application to use the camera, leave those features disabled. Shortcut, USB, and Bluetooth triggers do not require a camera. You can also review camera permissions in Windows privacy settings.
bullets: Processed locally
No face identification
No image saving, recording, or uploading
Disabled by default

zh.title: 触发后没有执行保护，应该先检查什么？
zh.description: Windows 隐私保护触发未生效时的基础排查顺序。
zh.shortAnswer: 先确认对应触发已启用、目标设备或摄像头当前可用，再用手动立即保护验证动作本身；随后查看应用中的触发记录和可理解的错误提示。

sections.heading: 把触发问题和动作问题分开
paragraphs: 如果手动立即保护能够正常执行，问题通常在快捷键冲突、设备识别、蓝牙连接或摄像头条件。若手动动作也失败，应先按页面提示处理 Windows 权限、登录状态或保险箱占用。
排查期间不要立即改用强制重启等更激烈的动作。先使用锁屏或隐藏窗口确认基本链路，并记录发生时间、选择的触发和屏幕上显示的错误码，便于后续支持。
bullets: 确认功能开关与目标设备
先测试手动保护
查看触发记录和错误码
一次只调整一个条件

en.title: What should I check first when a trigger does not protect the PC?
en.description: A basic troubleshooting order when a Windows privacy trigger does not act.
en.shortAnswer: Confirm that the trigger is enabled and its device or camera is available, then use manual Protect Now to test the action itself. Review the in-app trigger history and understandable error message afterward.

sections.heading: Separate the trigger from the action
paragraphs: If manual protection works, investigate shortcut conflicts, device recognition, Bluetooth connectivity, or camera conditions. If the manual action also fails, follow the page guidance for Windows permissions, sign-in state, or files still in use.

Do not immediately switch to a forceful restart while troubleshooting. Verify the basic flow with Windows lock or window hiding, and note the time, selected trigger, and displayed error code for support.
bullets: Confirm the feature switch and target device
Test manual protection first
Review trigger history and error code
Change one condition at a time

zh.title: 蓝牙设备还在身边，为什么会被判断为断开？
zh.description: 解释蓝牙省电、无线干扰和距离变化造成的短暂断连，并给出调整方向。
zh.shortAnswer: 蓝牙在设备休眠、手机后台限制、无线干扰或信号边缘时都可能短暂断开。先查看断开发生规律，再增加确认时间或更换更稳定的设备。

sections.heading: 先判断是不是连接质量问题
paragraphs: 耳机尤其容易因省电进入休眠，因此不一定适合判断人在不在。手机和手环也可能受系统策略影响，应在您实际使用的距离和环境中观察。
调整期间把保护结果限制为锁屏等容易恢复的动作。如果短暂断开频繁出现，即使延迟后仍不稳定，也应改用 U 盘或快捷键，而不是不断提高触发灵敏度。
bullets: 更新设备电量并减少无线遮挡
允许短暂断连恢复
必要时更换触发设备或方式

en.title: Why is a nearby Bluetooth device reported as disconnected?
en.description: Understand brief disconnects caused by power saving, interference, and range, and how to tune the trigger.
en.shortAnswer: Bluetooth can briefly disconnect because of device sleep, phone background restrictions, radio interference, or the edge of signal range. Observe the pattern, then allow more confirmation time or choose a more stable device.

sections.heading: Check connection quality first
paragraphs: Headphones commonly sleep to save power and may be poor presence indicators. Phones and wearables can also be affected by operating-system policies, so observe them at your real working distance and location.

While tuning, limit the result to an easily recoverable action such as Windows lock. If brief disconnects remain common even with a delay, use USB or a shortcut instead of continually increasing sensitivity.
bullets: Keep the device charged and reduce radio obstruction
Allow a brief disconnect to recover
Change the device or trigger method if needed

zh.title: 蓝牙显示已连接，为什么不能直接判断设备就在电脑旁？
zh.description: 解释蓝牙配对、连接、广播和信号强度为什么不能单独证明设备就在 Windows 电脑旁。
zh.shortAnswer: “已连接”只说明设备之间存在逻辑连接，不等于设备处于某个准确距离。墙体、人体遮挡、发射功率、省电策略和无线干扰都会改变蓝牙状态与信号强度。

sections.heading: 不同蓝牙信号表达的是不同事实
paragraphs: 配对表示两台设备建立过信任关系；连接表示当前存在可用的逻辑链路；广播表示设备正在对外发送可发现信息；信号强度只反映当时接收到的无线能量。它们都不能单独换算成可靠的物理距离。
例如，隔着一面墙的设备仍可能保持连接，放在电脑旁的耳机也可能因休眠暂时停止活动。人体遮挡、设备朝向、电量和同频干扰还会让信号强度在设备没有移动时发生波动。
bullets: 已配对不等于当前在场
已连接不等于距离很近
信号强度不是精确测距
耳机休眠可能改变连接表现

sections.heading: 隐私触发应采用保守判断
paragraphs: 如果把蓝牙用于隐私保护，不应因为某一次状态变化或某一个信号值就立即执行高影响动作。更稳妥的做法是观察短时间内的连续变化、允许短暂恢复，并先选择锁屏等容易恢复的结果。
蓝牙环境长期不稳定时，应改用快捷键、手动保护或 U 盘拔出等更明确的触发方式。软件不判断用户正在保护什么，用户自行决定合法合规的保护内容、触发方式和动作。
bullets: 不要依赖单次采样
为短暂波动保留确认时间
先使用容易恢复的保护动作
不稳定时更换触发方式

en.title: Why does Bluetooth 'connected' not prove a device is next to the PC?
en.description: Why pairing, connection, advertising, and signal strength cannot independently prove that a Bluetooth device is next to a Windows PC.
en.shortAnswer: Connected means that a logical link exists; it does not prove an exact physical distance. Walls, the human body, transmit power, power-saving behavior, and radio interference all affect connection state and signal strength.

sections.heading: Each Bluetooth signal represents a different fact
paragraphs: Pairing means the devices established trust before. Connection means a usable logical link currently exists. Advertising means a device is transmitting discovery information. Signal strength represents received radio energy at that moment. None of these alone provides reliable physical distance.

A device behind a wall may remain connected, while headphones next to the PC may sleep and briefly stop activity. Body obstruction, device orientation, battery level, and radio interference can also change signal strength without any movement.
bullets: Paired does not mean currently present
Connected does not mean very close
Signal strength is not precise ranging
Headphone sleep can change connection behavior

sections.heading: Use conservative decisions for privacy triggers
paragraphs: A Bluetooth privacy trigger should not perform a high-impact action because of one state change or one signal reading. A safer approach observes a short sequence of changes, allows brief recovery, and starts with an easily reversible result such as Windows lock.

If Bluetooth remains unstable in the real environment, choose a clearer trigger such as a shortcut, manual protection, or USB removal. The software does not decide what the user is protecting; the user chooses lawful content, triggers, and actions.
bullets: Do not depend on one sample
Allow confirmation time for brief fluctuations
Start with reversible protection actions
Change the trigger when the environment is unstable

比较快捷键、USB、蓝牙和摄像头触发
related.en: Compare shortcut, USB, Bluetooth, and camera triggers

zh.title: 强制锁定、重启或关机会影响未保存文件吗？
zh.description: 说明强制保护、重启和关机对未保存工作与正在使用文件的影响。
zh.shortAnswer: 会。强制关闭、强制锁定或卸载、重启和关机都可能中断应用并造成未保存内容丢失，因此默认不应启用，只适合明确接受后果的高风险场景。

sections.heading: 高影响动作不能替代日常保存
paragraphs: 应用可能正在写入文档、数据库或保险箱中的文件。突然终止或移除存储会让未完成的写入丢失，个别文件还可能需要应用自身的恢复流程。
优先使用隐藏窗口和 Windows 锁屏。如果确实需要更强动作，应缩小适用场景、延长确认时间，并用可丢弃数据演练。重要数据必须有独立备份。
bullets: 默认关闭强制动作
先保存并关闭正在使用的文件
用可丢弃数据测试
保持独立备份

en.title: Can force-lock, restart, or shutdown affect unsaved files?
en.description: Understand how forceful protection, restart, and shutdown affect unsaved work and open files.
en.shortAnswer: Yes. Force-close, force-lock or unmount, restart, and shutdown can interrupt applications and lose unsaved content. They should remain disabled by default and be used only when you accept the consequences.

sections.heading: High-impact actions do not replace saving
paragraphs: An application may be writing a document, database, or file inside the vault. Sudden termination or storage removal can discard incomplete writes, and some files may require the application's recovery process.

Prefer window hiding and Windows lock. If a stronger action is truly needed, narrow its scenario, allow more confirmation time, and rehearse with disposable data. Maintain an independent backup for important data.
bullets: Keep forceful actions disabled by default
Save and close files in use
Test with disposable data
Maintain an independent backup

zh.title: 忘记保险箱密码后，应该怎么办？
zh.description: 忘记 BitLocker 保险箱密码时，使用恢复材料并避免破坏原保险箱的处理原则。
zh.shortAnswer: 先停止反复尝试和任何可能覆盖原保险箱的操作，找到创建时保存的恢复材料并按恢复流程处理。没有密码或有效恢复材料时，不应承诺能够解密数据。

sections.heading: 保护原件，再尝试恢复
paragraphs: 先确认手中的保险箱文件没有被移动到不可靠介质，也不要新建同名文件覆盖它。检查您单独保管的恢复材料、密码管理器和备份记录。
联系支持时只提供页面要求的错误码和非敏感环境信息，不要发送密码、恢复密钥、保险箱内部文件名或内容。保险箱恢复不等于数据备份，恢复前应保留原件副本。
bullets: 不要覆盖或删除原保险箱
寻找单独保管的恢复材料
保留原件和独立备份
不要向任何人发送密码或恢复密钥

en.title: What should I do if I forget the vault password?
en.description: Use recovery material and preserve the original vault when a BitLocker vault password is forgotten.
en.shortAnswer: Stop repeated guesses and any operation that could overwrite the original vault. Locate the recovery material saved during creation and follow the recovery flow. Decryption should not be promised without the password or valid recovery material.

sections.heading: Preserve the original before recovery
paragraphs: Confirm that the vault file has not been moved to unreliable storage, and do not create a same-named file over it. Check separately stored recovery material, password-manager entries, and backup records.

When contacting support, provide only requested error codes and non-sensitive environment information. Do not send the password, recovery key, names of files inside the vault, or file contents. Keep an original copy before attempting recovery.
bullets: Do not overwrite or delete the original vault
Find separately stored recovery material
Keep the original and an independent backup
Never send passwords or recovery keys to anyone
